driver: common/driver.cu: fps_kernel<float><<<B=2, 256>>>(src[B*N,3], ptr={0,N,2N}, out_ptr={0,M,2M}, start={0,0}, dist[B*N]=5e4, out[B*M], dim=3); args B N M default 2 512 128. Host FPS reference compares all sampled indices (mismatches=0/256 expected barring FMA near-ties).
input: 2 batches x 512 random points in [-1,1]^3 (fixed LCG), M=128 samples per batch (ratio 1/4). DEVIATION from the table ('the repo test's points', 8 points / 2 batches): with 4 points per batch threads >= 4 hold -1 and the reduction never executes the overwrite at a cross-warp stride (i = 32, 64, 128), so no cross-warp pair would run; N=512 gives each of the 256 threads two real points, so best_dist[t] < best_dist[t+i] holds in about half of all (t,i) at every stride. Grid/block (2, 256) as in the table.
access_estimate: about 3.1e6 thread-level memory accesses (per block and iteration: 512 points x 8 global accesses + 512 STS + about 1.8k reduction lanes x 4 + 256 LD of out[m-1] = about 1.2e4; x 127 iterations x 2 blocks).
